text.ms:

Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Draf Cadangan bagi Perubahan

Pelan Tempatan) (Perubahan 4) 2022.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 7 Mac 2022.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan draf cadangan perubahan Pelan Bandar Raya

Kuala Lumpur 2020 hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF DRAFT PROPOSAL

FOR ALTERATION OF LOCAL PLAN) (ALTERATION 4) RULES 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 64(2)(j) of the Federal Territory

(Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur,

with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning) (Fee for

Purchase of Draft Proposal for Alteration of Local Plan) (Alteration 4) Rules 2022.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 7 March 2022.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the draft proposal for the alteration of the

Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020 shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

 Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

Hard copy 200.00

Electronic form Download for free of charge

Made 28 February 2022
